scope: Targeted full-input connection and consumer comparison, not novelty proof.

matches.hypothesis: W2 uses overlap-weighted peer states only to read out confidence, while query refinement does not explicitly consume that competition context. A zero-initialized learned projection of full peer states into the next refinement may make masks and confidence co-adapt. Existing self-attention can represent peer interactions; neither missing information nor efficacy is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus q_next_input=q+C(q,masks,masses)@W, where C is the row-normalized off-diagonal soft point-mass-IoU weighted mean of raw peer queries. Shared W[256,256] starts at exact zero without RNG. Six feedback calls before coarse query-to-instance attention, seven unchanged confidence losses, released SPFormer, fixed30/seed1999 and native YAML.

matches.hypothesis: Native W2 adds projected sparse-3D and existing 2D appearance features before sum_norm. An explicit learned channel-product residual before that same normalization may ease visual interaction fitting. Existing downstream attention/MLPs may represent such interactions; neither missing information, novelty nor efficacy is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus fused=s+a+(s*a)@W for native projected spatial/appearance features; W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG (+65536 parameters), one call before original sum_norm. Original all-channel inputs and existing 2D features, mask features, query sampling, coarse/fine equal fusion, hard masks/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence calls/targets/losses/selector, released SPFormer, Q128/seed1999/fixed30 and native YAML are preserved. At zero, all parent weights/RNG/decoder outputs/input gradients anchor to W2.

matches.hypothesis: W2 refines visual instance states with language at every decoder stage but predicts all masks against the same static x_mask features. A shared zero-initialized residual from the current refined visual state into each later mask feature tensor may ease conditional mask fitting. Queries already carry contextual information; missing information, novelty and efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus mask_features_i=mask_features+clean(refined_visual_i)@W before the six loop prediction heads; W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG (+65536 parameters), padded rows zeroed, stage0 unchanged. Each call consumes current original ila_ffn output without accumulating previous residuals. Original shared confidence heads/targets/losses, mask-to-attention hard-gate algorithm, original SCG/k/gamma, query sampling, equal coarse/fine fusion, static x_mask, full inputs/existing2D data, released SPFormer, Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML remain unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: Each original refinement predicts fresh masks from its query and static mask features; the preceding mask enters only the detached Boolean attention gate. A learned direct residual from the immediately preceding mask logits may ease iterative support refinement. The query already carries history; missing information, novelty and trained efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Independent unchanged W2 plus adjusted_masks=raw_current_masks+tanh(original_current_query@w)*clean(previous_adjusted_masks), shared w[256,1] exactly zero/no RNG (+256). Six calls only, initial stage unchanged; padding positions of previous masks zeroed. Previous mask remains differentiable. Original score query/readout, static mask features, full input/existing2D/released backbone, all six refinements/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence calls/targets/losses/argmax, Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML and the exact native Boolean attention rule remain. No scalar sweep, threshold, loss/feature/epoch or validation selection.

matches.hypothesis: Native W2 predicts refined masks from each current query against expression-independent static mask features. A shared attention residual from the full current refined query set into each later mask feature tensor may ease instance-conditioned mask fitting. Existing language/query paths can carry equivalent context; missing information, novelty and trained efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Independent unchanged W2 plus mask_features_i=mask_base+clean((softmax(mask_base@current_refined_queries.T/sqrt(d))@current_refined_queries)@W), shared W[256,256] exactly zero/no RNG (+65536). Six calls before original loop prediction heads; original initial prediction unchanged, original static mask base reused without accumulating updates, padded residual rows zero. All128 queries and all channels retained and undetached. Original sampling/geometry/coarse-fine equal fusion/Boolean gate algorithm/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence heads/targets/losses/argmax, all inputs/existing2D/released backbone/Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML remain. Fixed standard sqrt(d) scaling only; no temperature/threshold/loss/feature/epoch/validation search.

matches.hypothesis: Original query readouts use LayerNorm while x_mask visual embeddings retain per-superpoint mean and magnitude. A single learned affine LayerNorm of all visual mask-feature channels before batching may change mask-fitting geometry. Removing magnitude/mean may also harm fitting; no native defect, missing information, novelty or efficacy is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Independent unchanged W2 except mask_feats=LayerNorm(x_mask(x)) once before original get_batches, used by all seven original mask/score readouts. New512 affine parameters, default original LayerNorm epsilon1e-5, no RNG. Native masks and gates may differ as the intended transform; no threshold/loss/epoch/feature scan. Bypassing only the new norm must restore all W2 outputs and input gradients.

matches.hypothesis: Original masks are a dot product between a normalized query and static visual features. A shared zero-initialized projection of squared normalized-query channels before only that dot product may ease nonlinear mask fitting. The query generator already represents nonlinear functions; no defect, missing information, novelty or benefit is presumed.

Keep all original channels, points, data, heads, norms, initial/recurrent query generation, coarse/fine average, self/language sum, 2D, backbone, coordinates, SCG, gates algorithm, targets/loss/selector, seed1999/fixed30 and original YAML. Zero anchors exact; nonzero mask response, original consumers and input gradients tested.

matches.hypothesis: Original static visual mask embeddings are used by a dot product with normalized queries. A shared zero-initialized projection of squared visual channels before original batching may ease visual-side nonlinear mask fitting. The original x_mask MLP already has nonlinear capacity; no defect, missing information, novelty or trained benefit is presumed.

A parallel learned linear residual from that SAME seed may ease initial-query fitting while retaining the complete nonlinear generator. The generator can already learn identity-like mappings; no missing information, defect, novelty or benefit is presumed.

matches.hypothesis: Original static mask features come from sparse spatial features, while the full existing 2D appearance features influence the query/visual-memory path. A separate learned direct full appearance residual into static mask features may ease appearance-sensitive mask fitting. Query interactions already carry appearance; no missing information, defect, novelty or benefit is presumed.

distinction: Y99 bypasses the complete original nonlinear static-mask MLP with the SAME full 32-channel sparse input, without adding or selecting inputs. Y98 instead routes full existing1024 appearance directly into masks; Y72 is recurrent refined visual state, Y81 is query-attended visual state and Y92 squares the already projected mask embeddings. No mechanism combination, resource substitution, rejected-route reopening or feature-subset scan.
